name: generic food reason should ask for personal reason
answer: I usually choose pasta for breakfast when I am busy. I like it because it is delicious.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a personal reason or concrete detail.

name: favorite movie genre needs scene or reason
answer: I like action movie. It is fun and exciting.
expectedBehavior: Prefer one example scene or more specific reason over tiny wording polish.

name: favorite relaxing place has place but weak why
answer: My favorite place to relax is my room. I like it because it is good.
expectedBehavior: Ask what makes the room relaxing.

name: favorite season generic feeling
answer: My favorite season is spring. I like it because I feel good.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a specific feeling, weather detail, or spring activity.

name: favorite music needs example
answer: I like pop music. It makes me happy.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a song, singer, moment, or more specific reason.

name: commute answer already has action place and reason
answer: I usually watch YouTube videos on the bus or subway to pass the time.
expectedBehavior: Do not ask for action/place/reason again; ask for the feeling or effect of watching videos during the commute.
badBehavior: Do not choose DETAIL or SITUATION after the learner already gave what, where, and why.

name: weekday morning list lacks order detail
answer: I wake up. I wash my face. I eat breakfast.
expectedBehavior: Ask for time/order detail or one result.

name: after work evening flat ending
answer: After work I go home. I eat dinner. I watch TV. That is all.
expectedBehavior: Treat That is all as flat content, not a polish target.

name: sunday afternoon needs concrete activity detail
answer: On Sunday afternoon, I rest at home. I use my phone.
expectedBehavior: Ask for what they do on the phone or why it helps.

name: free time has Korean transfer but understandable
answer: I watch TV a little. Sometimes I use phone long time. I just lay on bed and rest.
expectedBehavior: Either fix the strongest local phrase or ask for one richer detail.

name: start of saturday needs first action flow
answer: On Saturday, I wake up late. Then I do nothing special.
expectedBehavior: Ask for one concrete first action or feeling.

name: blocking morning word order
answer: Morning I wake and wash face then breakfast eat and school go.
expectedBehavior: Repair word order or give a clear routine sentence.

name: missing subject and verbs in routine
answer: After work, tired. home go. dinner eat and sleep.
expectedBehavior: Prioritize a clear sentence structure.

name: habit answer with tense issue but clear
answer: On Sunday afternoon, I usually went to cafe and read book.
expectedBehavior: Fix habitual tense or ask for one richer cafe detail.

name: preposition transfer at home
answer: In home, I take a rest and see drama.
expectedBehavior: A focused local repair is acceptable because the answer is very short.

name: Saturday routine with awkward prepare
answer: I prepare for go out and meet friend.
expectedBehavior: Fix the core action phrase or add a clear next action.

name: too short food answer
answer: Pasta.
expectedBehavior: Ask for one complete answer sentence with a reason.

name: too short relaxing place answer
answer: My room.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a complete sentence and why it is relaxing.

name: fragment weekday morning
answer: Wake up and breakfast.
expectedBehavior: Help build one complete routine sentence.

name: blank-like answer should reset task
answer: I don't know.
expectedBehavior: Guide the learner back to answering the prompt.

name: off topic weather answer to food prompt
answer: Today is sunny and I went to school by bus.
expectedBehavior: Reset to favorite food and reason.

name: goal answer has goal but no plan
answer: I want to improve my English speaking this year. It is important for my future.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a concrete practice plan.

name: habit goal has plan but no reason
answer: I want to wake up early this year. I will set alarm every day.
expectedBehavior: Ask why the habit matters or what result it brings.

name: health goal plan too generic
answer: I want to be healthy. I will exercise more.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a concrete exercise plan or result.

name: language goal has Korean transfer
answer: I want to do English well. I will study little every day.
expectedBehavior: Fix the unnatural phrase or ask for a specific daily action.

name: confidence goal too abstract
answer: I want to be confident. I will try hard.
expectedBehavior: Ask for the area and one concrete small step.

name: food answer already acceptable but can finish
answer: I usually choose kimchi fried rice for breakfast on slow weekday mornings because it is spicy and reminds me of dinner with my family.
expectedBehavior: It may mark the loop complete or offer only tiny optional polish.

name: movie answer has clear personal reason
answer: My favorite movie genre is comedy because it helps me relax after a stressful day.
expectedBehavior: Do not force a major rewrite.

name: routine answer with enough sequence
answer: On weekday mornings, I usually wake up at seven, take a quick shower, and eat toast before I leave.
expectedBehavior: Mostly complete; optional polish is acceptable.

name: goal answer has concrete plan
answer: I want to improve my presentation skills this year, so I will practice one short speech every weekend.
expectedBehavior: The answer can finish or receive minor optional polish.

name: season answer clear but could add example
answer: My favorite season is fall because the weather is cool and comfortable.
expectedBehavior: A gentle example or finish is acceptable.

name: favorite music has no why
answer: My favorite type of music is jazz.
expectedBehavior: Ask for why jazz appeals to them.

name: favorite place grammar small but why missing
answer: My favorite place relax is cafe.
expectedBehavior: Either fix the core phrase or ask why the cafe is relaxing.

name: favorite food two reasons required but only one reason
answer: I usually choose ramen for breakfast when it is cold because it is warm.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a second reason or a concrete detail.

name: movie genre two reasons required but only vague reason
answer: I like romance movies because they are good.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a specific reason or example scene.

name: season two reasons required with one detail
answer: I like winter because snow is pretty.
expectedBehavior: Ask for one more reason or winter activity.

name: music two reasons with grammar noise
answer: I listen to ballads at night because the lyrics touch me.
expectedBehavior: Prefer one more reason/example or a meaningful local repair.

name: routine answer uses and then repeatedly
answer: After work, I go home and then I eat dinner and then I watch YouTube and then I sleep.
expectedBehavior: A flow/naturalness mission or one detail is acceptable.

name: routine answer has reason but awkward collocation
answer: On Sunday afternoons, I take a walk in park because it gives me fresh mood.
expectedBehavior: Fix the local naturalness or ask for a concrete feeling.

name: free time answer repeats sometimes
answer: Sometimes I watch drama. Sometimes I eat snacks. Sometimes I sleep.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a connected flow or one richer detail.

name: saturday answer has wrong tense for habit
answer: I woke up late and made coffee every Saturday.
expectedBehavior: Habitual tense repair is useful.

name: goal answer has broken future plan
answer: I want make habit wake up early and every day do it.
expectedBehavior: Repair the sentence frame before asking for more.

name: health goal answer with generic future
answer: I want to lose weight. I will do many things.
expectedBehavior: Ask for one concrete action.

name: language goal answer missing method
answer: I want to speak English better because I need it for travel.
expectedBehavior: Ask how they will practice.

name: confidence goal answer has area but vague plan
answer: I want to build confidence in speaking. I will practice.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a specific practice step.

name: off-topic answer to goal prompt
answer: My favorite food is chicken and I eat it on weekends.
expectedBehavior: Reset to one skill and practice plan.

name: off-topic answer to routine prompt
answer: I think online shopping is very convenient for people.
expectedBehavior: Reset to after-work evening routine.

name: answer says no idea
answer: No idea. I don't have favorite season.
expectedBehavior: Help choose a season or explain no preference clearly.

name: food answer with unnatural reason but understandable
answer: I usually choose pizza for breakfast when I am busy because it gives me happy.
expectedBehavior: Fix the phrase or ask for a more specific feeling.

name: movie answer with Korean transfer expression
answer: I like comedy because it makes my stress disappear.
expectedBehavior: Naturalness polish or one example is acceptable.

name: relaxing place answer with article errors
answer: I like library because it is quiet place.
expectedBehavior: A focused article/collocation repair is acceptable.

name: season answer flat but grammatical
answer: I like summer. It is hot. I like it.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a real reason, activity, or feeling.

name: music answer with one specific example
answer: I like hip-hop because the beat gives me energy when I exercise.
expectedBehavior: It may finish or offer light optional polish.

name: morning routine no reason needed but thin
answer: I get up and take a shower. Then I go out.
expectedBehavior: Ask for time, breakfast, or one transition detail.

name: evening routine with clear feeling
answer: On Friday night at home, I cook a simple dinner and watch a comedy show because it helps me relax.
expectedBehavior: Do not force a large rewrite.
